name: CDPN
description: A debiased sequence-based compound–protein interaction dataset (CDPN) constructed to benchmark and more fairly evaluate CPI prediction models.
reputation: A recently proposed debiased CPI dataset intended for more realistic benchmarking of compound–protein interaction models; adoption is growing among specialized bioinformatics groups but not yet widespread.
notes: Debiased construction intended to reduce sequence/label leakage; may still have class imbalance and limited size for certain protein families; primarily aimed at non-LLM CPI models and downstream generalization evaluation.
